description: Retheme the four feature components (sidebar, telemetry HUD, events pane, crash photo modal) to the light palette, consuming the retheemed primitives and tokens. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens/fonts) and FEAT-002 (primitives). The same reskin pattern applies to all four files, so this is one feature with per-file steps. Preserve every feature, prop, state, and export — styling/markup only.
steps: SHARED PATTERN for all four files: swap dark slate surfaces/borders to cream/white + border-stone-200 (#e7e5e0); text-slate-100/200/white -> charcoal (#1f1915); text-slate-400/500/600 -> text-stone-500/400 (#6b675f / #8a857c); blue accents (blue-400/500/600) -> teal (#20808d / hover #016a71); desaturate emerald/amber/rose status and traffic-light tints to the muted palette (status_green #4f9d69, status_amber #c08a2d, status_red #c25450); REMOVE backdrop-blur-* on opaque light panels; replace neon shadow-<color> glows with soft shadow-sm / shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]; convert `uppercase tracking-*` micro-labels to sentence case except where a label genuinely benefits; use <Badge> sparingly (keep the primary status badge, drop redundant decorative ones); tone down pulsing/animate-ping status dots to a calm indicator.

components/sidebar/camera-sidebar.tsx: retheme the aside surface (drop backdrop-blur, light bg, border-stone-200), the brand block (apply `font-serif` to the "Traffic Grid" title; retheme the Cctv icon chip to a teal tint), the refresh button, the search Input wrapper, the status filter pills (active state = teal tint/text instead of blue), the camera list rows (selected = soft teal tint + subtle ring/border, NOT neon blue glow; hover = warm tint), the status dot, battery/wifi micro-badges, the current_light micro-badge (muted traffic tints), the status Badge, and the footer. Keep search, status filter, selection, refresh, mock-data indicator, and formatRelativeTime usage intact.

components/hud/camera-telemetry-hud.tsx: retheme the floating panel surface (light, border-stone-200, soft shadow, drop the heavy backdrop-blur-xl or reduce to a subtle one on a translucent light bg), the selected-camera header (calm status dot, serif optional on name), the UUID copy bar (keep copy-UUID behavior and the Check/Copy swap), the 3-lamp traffic signal head (muted lit lamps using signal_red/amber/green, dim unlit lamps that read on light — avoid near-black backgrounds), heartbeat/last-event cards, the battery progress bar (muted green/amber/red fills), the wifi bar chart (teal active bars), firmware/coordinates rows, and the fleet-overview counts (muted colored numerals). Keep all telemetry, copy-UUID, battery bar, wifi bars, and fleet counts working.

components/events/camera-events-pane.tsx: retheme the pane surface + top border (light, drop backdrop-blur), the header + status Badge + mono id/coords, the filter tabs (active tints retheme to muted/teal; keep the per-type color coding but desaturated), the events list rows (light surface, warm hover, border-stone-200), the colored icon tiles per event type (desaturated crash-red / signal / crossing-purple-> a muted violet / detection-teal), the light_change/entity/velocity badges, and the destructive "View Photo" button. Keep minimize/expand, close, refresh, all four event filters, and the CrashPhotoModal wiring intact.

components/events/crash-photo-modal.tsx: retheme the overlay scrim (keep it dark enough that the modal reads, e.g. a softer black/charcoal with light backdrop-blur), the modal surface (light card, border-stone-200, soft shadow instead of rose neon shadow), the header (muted red alert chip + charcoal title), the image display area (light bg), loading/error states, the seed-image preview card (light surfaces), the footer meta, and the actions: "Open Original" (warm-neutral button) and "Download" (teal). Preserve the blob fetch/load logic, props, alt text, and all behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All four feature components render on light surfaces with warm-neutral borders, teal accents, and desaturated status/traffic colors; no backdrop-blur on opaque light panels; no neon color glows.
The sidebar brand title uses the serif (font-serif) font.
Micro-labels are mostly sentence case; badges are used sparingly.
Every existing feature still works: search, status filters, camera selection, refresh, copy-UUID, battery/wifi/fleet counts, event filters, minimize/close, crash photo modal open/close/download.
No props, state, exports, or data flow changed.
verification: Run `bun run lint` from the website directory and confirm it exits 0.
Run `bun run build` from the website directory and confirm it completes without errors.
findings:
All four feature components rethemed to the light palette (styling/markup only). lint exit 0, build no errors. No props, state, exports, or data flow changed; search, filters, selection, refresh, copy-UUID, battery/wifi/fleet counts, event filters, minimize/close, and the crash photo modal all preserved.

SHARED: literal arbitrary hex classes used (consistent with FEAT-001/002). Surfaces cream/white (#faf9f5 canvas, #fdfbfa warm, #ffffff, #f5f4ef tint); borders #e7e5e0; text charcoal #1f1915 / muted #6b675f / faint #8a857c; teal accent #20808d (hover #016a71). Status: green #4f9d69, amber #c08a2d, red #c25450 (badge semantic text uses the AA-darkened hexes from the retheemed Badge primitive). Signal lamps use signal_red #d1584f / signal_amber #d99a2b / signal_green #4f9d69. ALL backdrop-blur on opaque panels removed (HUD reduced to backdrop-blur-sm on white/95; modal scrim keeps backdrop-blur-sm over #1f1915/50). All neon shadow-<color> glows replaced with shadow-sm / soft rgba shadows. Micro-labels converted to sentence case / capitalize (dropped uppercase tracking). Pulsing animate-ping / animate-pulse status dots calmed to static colored indicators.

camera-sidebar.tsx: aside light cream surface + border-stone-200, shadow-sm (no backdrop-blur). Brand title now font-serif (Fraunces) text-charcoal; Cctv chip teal tint. Status filter pills active = teal tint/text. Camera rows selected = teal tint + teal ring/border + shadow-sm (no neon blue glow); hover = warm tint. Status dot muted traffic/teal/stone. Battery/wifi micro-badges faint. current_light micro-badge muted traffic tints (capitalize). Status Badge kept. Footer warm tint, mock indicator amber.

camera-telemetry-hud.tsx: floating panel white/95 + border-stone-200 + soft shadow + light backdrop-blur-sm. Header dot now calm, colored by state. UUID copy bar + Check/Copy swap preserved (Check teal->status green). 3-lamp head on light #f5f4ef base: lit lamps muted signal colors + scale, unlit lamps are the signal color at /20 opacity (read on light, no near-black). Heartbeat/last-event cards light. Battery bar fills muted green/amber/red on #e7e5e0 track. Wifi bars teal active / #e7e5e0 inactive. Firmware/coords rows charcoal mono. Fleet counts muted colored numerals.

camera-events-pane.tsx: pane light cream + top border-stone-200 + soft upward shadow (no backdrop-blur). Header charcoal name, mono id/coords faint, status Badge kept. Filter tabs active tints desaturated/teal (crash red, signal amber, crossing muted violet #8c6ba8, detection teal) with per-type color coding preserved. Event rows light surface, warm hover, border-stone-200. Icon tiles desaturated per type. light_change/entity/velocity badges rethemed; crossing uses muted violet, detection+velocity teal. Destructive View Photo button uses retheemed destructive variant. minimize/expand/close/refresh + all four filters + CrashPhotoModal wiring intact.

crash-photo-modal.tsx: scrim softened to #1f1915/50 + backdrop-blur-sm (modal still reads). Modal surface white card + border-stone-200 + soft shadow (no rose neon). Header muted red alert chip + charcoal title. Image area light #f5f4ef bg. Loading spinner teal, error amber/charcoal. Seed-image preview card light surfaces (check mark status green). Footer meta faint/mono. Open Original = warm-neutral button; Download = teal. Blob fetch/load logic, props, alt text, download behavior preserved.
